messages:
Zoe Kim: Quick kickoff for the benchmark launch email sequence — need a tight newsletter + webinar nurture. Target: 1) drive 1.5k webinar RSVPs, 2) 3k benchmark downloads. Proposed flow: Invite -> Reminder -> Last-chance -> Recording -> Highlights.
Evan Li: I’ll map segmentation. Suggest 4 segments: customers (high-touch), active trials, engaged newsletter (last 60d opens >=2), and cold (no opens 90d). Different CTAs per segment.
Samir Patel: Subject line experiments: Personalized vs metric-first vs curiosity. We'll do 20/40/40 split on engaged cohort, seed with 5% sample. Examples: "Zoe — live benchmark walkthrough (register)" / "New benchmark: inference cost per token, real numbers" / "What we learned benchmarking open models".
Deliverability Bot: Reminder: include List-Unsubscribe header, avoid >60% image-to-text ratio, and set proper DKIM for campaign.sub.redwood.ai. If total send >25k, throttle by batch.
Evan Li: Send timing: customers Tue 10:00 PT, trials Wed 11:00 PT, engaged Thu 08:00 PT (split 08:00 & 09:30 if >15k), cold Fri 06:00 PT (APAC friendly).
Zoe Kim: Copy brief: Invite = bold hook + 2 bullets (what you'll learn) + CTA. Reminder = add speaker creds + 1 evidence datapoint. Last-chance = social proof + urgency. Recording = TL;DR + link. Highlights = 5 datapoints + download CTA.
Samir Patel: UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_mar, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content={{segment}}_{{variant}}. Also add ae_owner param when sent via AE.
Evan Li: Segment filters (export-ready): customers: tag:customer AND active_30d:true; trials: tag:trial AND last_event_14d:gte; engaged: opt_in:newsletter AND opens_60d:gte2; cold: opt_in:newsletter AND opens_90d:0.
Deliverability Bot: QA: seeds (support@, product@, 3 staff inboxes), check render on Gmail/Outlook/Apple, verify unsubscribe, test personalization tokens on 100 random addresses, run spam test on Litmus. Hold if spam score >5.
Zoe Kim: Ops Bot  please create campaign skeleton and assign tasks: segmentation (Evan), subject tests (Samir), deliverability QA (Evan), copy drafts (me). Dry run 4 days before send.
Ops Bot: Created campaign "Benchmark Launch Mini-Nurture" and checklist. Tasks assigned with due dates. Dry run scheduled.
Samir Patel: A/B rules: pick winner at 24h for engaged cohort, then apply to remainder. For customers/trials we prefer personalized subject only. For cold cohort, avoid tokens.
Evan Li: Suppress: downloaded_report_45d:true, unsubscribed_product:true, hard_bounce_90d:true, ae_opt_out:true. Also remove any emails flagged spam_trap.
Zoe Kim: I'll drop the short invite + reminder copy into the doc later today. Let's keep the newsletter creative minimal to maximize deliverability. Thanks :sparkles:
